Now read the sentences and find the key words. Think about possible synonyms and antonyms for these words.

Dr Garcia says:

1 … teenagers should go to bed after ten o’clock.

2 … we all have the same kind of body clock.

3 … we shouldn’t go online before we go to bed.

4 … the bright light from our phones or tablets tells our brains that it isn’t daytime.

staticText.text:
Build your potential | Listening for synonyms and antonyms

Sometimes you have to check information when you listen.

• Before you listen, carefully read the sentences that you have to check.

• Underline the key words in each sentence.

• You probably won’t hear the same words in the listening, so listen for synonyms (words that mean the same) and antonyms (words that mean the opposite).
